scripts.db:docker: npm run sync:dev-env && docker compose --env-file .env.docker up -d mes-postgres
scripts.db:restore: npm run sync:dev-env && npm run db:docker && npm run db:restore --prefix server
scripts.dev: npm run sync:dev-env && concurrently -n api,ui -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
